lines.en: I swim slowly through the water.
I am a size larger than I used to be.
I swing my body forward.
I rise to the surface, then sink.
I glide along the riverbed.

lines.zh: 我绕过一丛水草继续走。
lines.en: I go around a clump of weeds and on.
I crawl slowly up the bank.
I make a circuit of this stretch of water.
I roll back into the deep weeds.
I hop forward.

lines.zh: 石缝窄，我收起身子钻过去。
lines.en: The gap is narrow; I tuck in and slip through.
I travel along the muddy bank.
I float, my body pulsing.

lines.zh: 我一张嘴，泡泡一串串冒。
lines.en: I open my mouth and bubbles stream up.
Water slips past my sides.

lines.zh: 水底有声音，我侧耳听着。
lines.en: A sound on the bottom; I listen close.
I am heavier than I look.

lines.zh: 我浮在这儿等我主人来。
lines.en: I float here waiting for my tamer.
My color fades in the water.
The water holds me and I sway gently.
The bottom's deep enough for me.
I let out air and float a bit higher.
This water does not frighten me at all.
I turned about, slow and heavy.
I can see the stones on the bottom.

lines.zh: 我喉咙里滚出一点低鸣。
lines.en: A faint rumble rolls in my throat.
I surface and face you.
You are half crouched on the muddy bank.
I swim your way.
You are my tamer.
I lift my upper body out of the water.
I blow a bubble for you.
I watch you half-submerged.
Put your hand in the water.
I circle where you crouch.
I am bigger than when you last saw me.
Nothing in the water frightens me.
Hugging the mud, I inch toward you.
The water stretches my shadow.

lines.zh: 我浮在你面前，等你出声。
lines.en: I float before you, waiting for your call.

lines.zh: 你身上有幼年饲料的味。
lines.en: You smell of In-Training feed.
I keep against the wet stones of the bank.
I slipped out of its grip.

lines.zh: 我整个钟形都缩起来了。
lines.en: My whole bell clamped shut.
That pressed me flat.
I sank to the bottom and came back up.
I sloshed like a pot of soup.
I gave a thin cry.
I spread into a sheet.

lines.zh: 我慢慢凝回原来的样子。
lines.en: I slowly set back into my shape.
I am still floating on the surface.
I lean against the stone at the bank.
Is that In-Training feed?
I swam the whole of me over.
I can swallow this.

lines.zh: 我一口就把它吞下去了。
lines.en: I swallowed it in one gulp.
Give me a little more.
I have eaten this before.
I coil around your wrist.

lines.zh: 我怕被抢，吃得狼吞虎咽。
lines.en: I gulp it down, afraid of being robbed.
Is there more on your hand?
I drag it into the water.
I gulp and keep my eye on you.
With a little more I will grow sturdier.
You touch me and I slip away.
I am sturdier than I was.
I was shoved off and floated back.
The water makes me a little lighter.

lines.zh: 我被撞得在水里转了个身。
lines.en: The bump spun me around in the water.
Rings rippled outward.
I drifted straight again.

lines.zh: 我比小时候沉得多，别踩。
lines.en: I am much heavier than I was; do not step on me.
Bumped, I sink first, then float up.
That did not provoke me.
Ask me again when I'm grown.
These things I haven't figured out.
I settle slowly down to the bottom.
Ask me after I digivolve.
I'm not grown yet; not these things.
One tail beat and I am off elsewhere.
I blow bubbles by way of an answer.
Ask me when I am Jellymon.
I want only to eat my fill.
I am here, waiting for you to call.

lines.zh: 我用整个身子把它裹住。
lines.en: I wrap my whole body around it.

lines.zh: 这玩意儿硬，我咽不下去。
lines.en: This thing's hard; I can't swallow it.
It sank all the way down.

lines.zh: 我从底下拱它，让它浮起来。
lines.en: I heave from below and make it float.
This is too heavy for me to buoy.
I flicked it with a tentacle.
I tried holding it in my mouth.

lines.zh: 我用头顶着它，推到你脚边。
lines.en: I nudge it with my head to your feet.
I will hide this under a stone.
It drifted off downstream.
I pushed above water and lifted my bell.
Something under the water is moving.

lines.zh: 我的伞身鼓紧，水都撑开了。
lines.en: My bell tightens and pushes the water out.
My cheeks are already full of air.
I set myself between you and the water.

lines.zh: 我发出一个闷闷的声音。
lines.en: I made a muffled sound.

lines.zh: 在水里，我转身比谁都快。
lines.en: In water, I turn faster than anything.
This time I moved first.
I drift that way.
I will guard my tamer.
The water carries my voice further.
My position is set.
I press along with the current.
You climb the bank and I follow in close.
I am faster below the surface.
There is still air in my bell.

lines.zh: 我贴着你的侧边游，不落后。
lines.en: I swim at your flank, never falling behind.
The weeds block me; I go around.
I broke the surface again.
The air is at my mouth.
It is too near the water's edge.
One more foot and it is enough.
My body puffs up.
This one rolls up from underneath.
I bounded up and pressed down.
I puff my cheeks and spit a burst of bubbles.
I drive up hard from the riverbed.

lines.zh: 整个身体带着水压下来。
lines.en: My whole body comes down with the water's weight.
The bubbles burst in the water.
I laid my whole body over it.

lines.zh: 它躲开了，我只拍在水上。
lines.en: It dodged and I only slapped the water.
My own weight carried me aside.
I rose again from the bottom.
I bore down all the way with that one.
It backed out of the shallows.
I circled to its flank in the water.
A shape appears in the water.
I surfaced completely.

lines.zh: 我撑着前鳍，从浅水爬上泥岸。
lines.en: I brace on my fins and crawl up the muddy bank.
This water is clear to the bottom.
I blow a few bubbles.
I poke above water and look around.

lines.zh: 我从水里发出一声闷响。
lines.en: I made a muffled sound from the water.

lines.zh: 我背上的水草还没掉干净。
lines.en: Weeds still cling to my back.
A living person is standing on the bank.
I stop at the weeds.

lines.zh: 深水里，我一点点浮上来。
lines.en: From the deep, I rise little by little.

lines.zh: 我漂回了这块熟悉的水。
lines.en: I drifted back to this familiar water.
The water heats and I sink deeper.

lines.zh: 我摔在河岸上，滚了两圈。
lines.en: I hit the riverbank and rolled twice.

lines.zh: 水我倒不怕，只是太多了。
lines.en: I do not fear water; there is simply too much.

lines.zh: 爆风把我整团抛出了水面。
lines.en: The blast flung my whole mass out of the water.

lines.zh: 那东西扎进我的伞身，留下个洞。
lines.en: It pierced my bell and left a hole.

lines.zh: 一股力定住了水，我也停了。
lines.en: Some force stills the water and I stop with it.
Hunger leaves me unable to float.

lines.zh: 雷顺着水串上来，我整个钟形都麻了。
lines.en: Lightning ran up through the water and numbed my whole bell.
No water; I cannot float.
